description: Portable BT4decomp installation layout. Development evidence stays outside the game folder.
development_artifacts: Keep test reports, screenshots, source archives, build outputs, backups and distribution ZIPs outside the game installation. Do not delete unknown user files automatically.
separate_installer: BT4decomp-setup.exe installs the game; Install.exe is an identical compatibility entry point. The GitHub authorization helper stays under tbo/setup. Language packages use this project repository.
